description: Every open perpetual futures position on every connected exchange account: side, size, entry, mark, open profit or loss, leverage, the liquidation price with how far away it is, and the trade plan left on it (set_position_exit_plan). Use first in a new session, and before closing, adjusting a stop or reporting exposure. Not for resting orders or stops (use get_my_open_orders). No inputs. Sizes in the base coin, prices in USD. Next: close_position or get_my_open_orders.
name: get_my_positions

created_at.description: When it was set, ISO 8601 UTC

created_by.description: Agent id that set the plan, or person

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

rules.description: The rules, each fired at most once

status.description: active, done, ended, replaced or cancelled

thesis.description: Why the position is held, as its author wrote it; present only for the agent that wrote it and the person

close_fraction.description: close: share of the position it closes, a fraction (0.5 = half)

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

fired_at.description: When it fired, ISO 8601 UTC; null while waiting

outcome.description: notified, closed, or the error code that stopped the close

value.description: price_*: USD per coin; held_hours: hours since the plan was set; funding_above: yearly rate this position pays, as a fraction (0.5 = 50%)

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

funding_paid_usd.description: Funding this position has paid since funding_since, USD (received is negative), from the exchange's records; 0 in the sandbox; absent when TradeHub did not open it

funding_since.description: When TradeHub opened it (its oldest open trade), ISO 8601 UTC

liquidation_distance_pct.description: How far the mark is from the liquidation price, as a fraction (0.12 = 12%); keep the stop well inside it

liquidation_price.description: Where the exchange would liquidate this position, USD per coin, as the exchange reports it; absent where there is no liquidation (the sandbox)

plan.description: The trade plan on this position (set_position_exit_plan), if any

size_base.description: Position size, in the base coin (e.g. BTC), not USD (close_position takes the same name)

stop_rule.description: The automatic stop rule following this position, if any

activate_at.description: Price from which the rule acts, USD per coin

best_price.description: Best mark since the rule was set, USD per coin

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

last_stop.description: Stop this rule last set, USD per coin

moves.description: How many times it moved the stop

status.description: active, done, ended, replaced or cancelled

trail_pct.description: Trailing distance behind the best price, as a fraction (0.02 = 2%)

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

positions.description: Open positions on every connected venue

title: My open positions
